svg.text: East node - Hebron, KY | 49,000 sq ft, 32 ft clear
To scale. 205 x 175 ft. Inbound west, reserve racking across the back, forward pick, then Sure Sort and pack across the front. Outbound and mail staging east. People and forklifts shown for scale.
Grid squares are 25 ft. Racking 4 levels at 24 ft with pallet loads shown; Sure Sort bed 130 x 12 ft with bin walls both sides; 8 pack stations; two-storey office.
